Subject: Request: short-term reserved tranche for enterprise onboarding

Hi Jonas / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the clinicians at NovaHealth want to run a 2-week pilot with live traffic (teletriage) and need predictable latency while we validate model outputs. We expect a spike during business hours: roughly 1.2M tokens/day peak, with sustained 250k tokens/day baseline.

Can Redwood provision a short-term dedicated tranche (isolated GPUs) for the onboarding window (target start Sep 20, duration 3 weeks) and temporarily relax the autoscale preemption policy so our scheduled sweeps don't get evicted mid-eval? We understand this is an exception request — please advise what you need from us (SOW, signed MOU, billing PO).

Attaching: nova_onboarding_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

Quick capacity note (summary of internal sizing assessment):
- Baseline recommendation: 8xA100-equivalent (q4 quantized variant) to meet 250k tokens/day baseline with <120ms p95 latency.
- Peak buffer: allow 2x additional instances for business-hour spikes (total 10x), enforced as a time-limited burst pool (09:00–18:00 local).
- Autoscale exception proposal: enable burst scaling to the 2x instances during defined business hours only, and disable burst overnight (00:00–06:00). If the pool needs to be preempted for priority traffic, fallback rules: route to compatible quantized variant (lower cost/higher latency) or redirect a fraction of traffic to hosted multi-tenant endpoints with throttling.

Operational constraints: this increases risk to fleet headroom across the us-east region — we'll require an explicit approver from Capacity (cc'ing ops lead) and a signed MOU covering the reserve billing and eviction policy. See excerpt attached.

Attachments: capacity_runbook_excerpt.txt (text, 6KB)

If Sales approves, we can schedule a short ops readiness call + create a temporary reservation in the allocator for Sep 19 (warmup) and Sep 20 go-live.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Capacity Planner | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: short-term reserved tranche for enterprise onboarding — APPROVED (time-boxed)

Sarah — good news: we approved a time-boxed dedicated tranche for NovaHealth. Summary of agreed terms: 
- Capacity: 8xA100-equivalent reserved, with a 2x burst buffer during business hours (09:00–18:00 local).
- Duration: Sep 20 — Oct 10, 2026 (3 weeks). Warmup slot Sep 19.
- Autoscale exception: allowed during business hours only; disabled overnight. Fallback: quantized compatible model or hosted throttling if preemption needed.
- Billing: short-term reservation rate + overage, invoice after go-live.
- Approvals: Kimberly (sales) approved the exception conditioned on an ops runbook and signed MOU.

Next steps for NovaHealth (action items):
1) Please countersign the attached MOU (DocuSign link below) so Karthik can create the temporary reservation in the allocator.
2) Ops readiness call: Mon Sep 19 10:00 PT — we'll run warmup and KV cache priming.
3) Share PO if you want formal invoicing terms; otherwise we'll bill per the MOU.
